recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Lemon and Dill
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper or foil.
Arrange salmon fillets skin-side down on the prepared baking sheet, leaving space between each fillet.
Drizzle olive oil evenly over each fillet, and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Scatter chopped fresh dill over the top of the salmon.
Arrange thin slices of fresh lemon over each fillet to infuse flavor and retain moisture during baking.
Bake uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately with pan juices spooned on top.
recipes.swaps: Can substitute fresh parsley or tarragon for dill; lime slices can replace lemon.
recipes.notes: Equipment: Rimmed baking sheet, parchment paper or foil. Light, clean preparation suitable for busy weeknights.
